meta.name: prioritization-frameworks
meta.description: Reference guide to 9 prioritization frameworks with formulas, when-to-use guidance, and templates — RICE, ICE, Kano, MoSCoW, Opportunity Score, and more. Use when selecting a prioritization method, comparing frameworks like RICE vs ICE, or learning how different prioritization approaches work.

copy.tagline: 选择并应用合适的优先级框架来决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个方案中决定先做什么
copy.tagline_en: Choose and apply the right prioritization framework for decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide what to work on first among many options

howto.what: Claude 会作为优先级框架参考指南，提供 9 种框架的公式、适用场景和模板，包括 RICE、ICE、Kano、MoSCoW、机会评分等。它能帮你选择框架、比较方法，并推荐优先排序客户问题。
howto.when: 当你询问如何选择优先级框架、比较 RICE 与 ICE 等不同方法，或想了解某个框架的用法时触发。

say.text: 帮我比较 RICE 和 ICE 框架，哪个更适合我的团队？
say.note: Claude 会解释两者区别并给出建议。

say.text: 用机会评分法帮我分析客户需求优先级。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提供重要性和满意度数据。

say.text: 给我一个 MoSCoW 模板用于需求分类。
say.note: Claude 会提供模板和用法说明。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a reference guide for 9 prioritization frameworks, providing formulas, when-to-use guidance, and templates including RICE, ICE, Kano, MoSCoW, Opportunity Score, and more. It helps select frameworks, compare methods, and recommends prioritizing customer problems.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about selecting a prioritization method, comparing frameworks like RICE vs ICE, or learning how different prioritization approaches work.

say_en.text: Compare RICE and ICE frameworks. Which is better for my team?
say_en.note: Claude explains differences and gives recommendations.

say_en.text: Use Opportunity Score to prioritize customer needs.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to provide importance and satisfaction data.

say_en.text: Give me a MoSCoW template for requirements.
say_en.note: Claude provides template and usage instructions.
